Statement of Purpose

"I exist at the intersection of financial analysis and intelligent automation — where spreadsheets meet systems, where risk models meet real decisions, and where the chaos of markets gets converted into clarity."

Who I Am

I'm Vinay Jain, a final-year BBA student majoring in Economics & Finance at Mahindra University, Hyderabad — consistently ranked Top 10 across three consecutive years with a CGPA of 9.51. Beyond academics, I'm the Founder & CEO of VinAI Technologies and a Programme Director who trained 450+ MBA students.

I hold professional qualifications in Actuarial Science (ACET Distinction, cleared CM1/CS1/CB1/CB2) and Enterprise Risk Management (IRM, UK) — and recently won the National GOER 2025 with a ₹1 Lakh prize.
